translations.source_sense_description: имеющий большее количество лет по сравнению с кем-либо, более старый или самый старый по возрасту

glosses: comparative degree of old: older, greater than another in age or seniority.

examples.text: It's typical for elder married couples to live in retirement homes.
The elder of the two was also an elder statesman.
She removed Stranleigh’s coat with a dexterity that aroused his imagination. The elder woman returned with dressings and a sponge, which she placed on a chair.

glosses: A leader or senior member of a tribe or community, often of considerable age, respected as an authority figure, especially in a counselling, consultative, or ceremonial role.

examples.text: We were presented to the village elder.
At the friendship centre, you can arrange to meet with a social worker or an elder.
People saw in the elders, who were closer to death, the manifestation of the divine force that was thought to achieve its full liberation at death.

I probably wouldn't be here talking about this very topic if it weren't for the few but mighty elders in the tech and gender rights spaces. Folks like South Africa-based Jan Moolman from the Association for Progressive Communications[…]

glosses: An old person.

examples.text: Treating illness among society’s elders is challenging since board-certified geriatricians (physicians trained, knowledgeable and certified in treating older patients) are in short supply, here in El Paso and throughout the country.

glosses: One who is older than another.

examples.text: Respect your elders.

glosses: One who lived at an earlier period; a predecessor.

examples.text: Carry your Head[…] as your Elders have done.

glosses: An officer of a church, sometimes having teaching responsibilities.
A clergyman authorized to administer all the sacraments.

glosses: One ordained to the lowest office in the Melchizedek priesthood.

examples.text: After being a member of the Church for a while, Bill was ordained to the office of elder.

glosses: A male missionary.

examples.text: The elders are coming over for dinner tonight.

glosses: Title for a male missionary; title for a general authority.

examples.text: One of the long-time leaders in the Church is Elder Packer.

glosses: A pagan or Heathen priest or priestess.
To admonish or reprove for improper conduct by the elders of the meeting.

examples.text: I was eldered for directly responding to someone else's message in meeting for worship.

glosses: A small tree, Sambucus nigra, having white flowers in a cluster, and edible purple berries.

glosses: Any of the other species of the genus Sambucus: small trees, shrubs or herbaceous perennials with red, purple, or white/yellow berries (some of which are poisonous).
